text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Cake flour... if I prepare just this much 
extra...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower busily heads into the 
kitchen. Curious, I take a peek inside—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting...! This time 
for sure, let's make something wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged. Proceeding to Mission: 
'Dough Preparation' as scheduled.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. We're borrowing the kitchen 
to do some baking right now.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is not mere baking. It is Mission: 
'Wedding Confectionery Preparation.'

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, a friend of mine asked for help—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Handmade sweets for your older sister's 
wedding?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, since it's a special occasion, I 
want to make something truly special! 
...But I just can't come up with any good 
ideas...

text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend
text_block_list.text:
I've tried making all sorts of prototypes, 
but... if only I were as good with my 
hands as you are, Flower-chan.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um! If it's alright, I can try making 
some test batches too! Maybe it'll give 
you some inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Thank you so much~!! Please do! 
I'll keep experimenting on my end too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...So I took on the request, but nothing 
has clicked yet. I wonder what kind of 
sweets are suitable for a wedding...
choice_data_list:
Maybe you could ask someone else for 
advice?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I concur. Individual Flower is currently 
in Status: 'Deadlock.' External input is 
required to resolve this bottleneck.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Filtering Tracen Academy student database 
under specified parameters... Flash-san, 
whose parents operate a confectionery 
shop, is evaluated as the optimal 
candidate.
choice_data_list:
You'll wear yourself out if you carry the 
whole burden alone.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Sky-san told me something 
similar before.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll go ask Flash-san! If we can hear a 
fresh perspective, I'm sure a great idea 
will come to mind!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, optimal firmness requires 1 minute 
and 23 seconds more.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The dough will take 40 minutes and 15 
seconds to bake. Let us complete the prep 
work for decorations in the meantime.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Arranging seasonal fruits at the 
predetermined ratio, spreading cream 
evenly—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Complete.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Amazing...! That's Flash-san for you! It's 
so beautiful, luxurious, and precise—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Did any good ideas come to mind?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...No, not yet. I can't help but wonder if 
something thought up by an amateur like me 
is really good enough...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Flower-san, whether one is a professional 
or an amateur has no bearing on the 
finished confectionery. ...My father once 
told me when I was young:

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely. Sweets are the 
crystallized form of a prayer for 
someone's happiness.

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
A precise recipe and optimal 
ingredients—only when combined with the 
baker's heartfelt feelings do they become 
truly delicious sweets.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Therefore, rather than worrying about 
whether it will succeed, I want you to 
trust your own feelings when you bake.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: My... heartfelt feelings...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Just like everyone who has supported me, 
I want to support someone else too—)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Being able to help through baking makes 
me so happy, and I want to be there for my 
friend. That's why...!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Detecting Status: 'Inspiration' from 
Flower-san. Flash-san, this is—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. It seems she has found her answer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Roses made of financiers, gerberas made of 
meringue. Finally, wrapping them with 
baby's breath to form a bouquet—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
'To my dearest beloved, may your future be 
filled with hope and light. ...Wishing you 
boundless happiness.'

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the other day! My 
friend's older sister was overjoyed♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And so, to express my gratitude, I made 
some for you all as well—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The confectionery bouquet developed during 
Mission: 'Wedding Confectionery 
Preparation'... You made this for us?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ It's a mini-bouquet size, but I 
poured all my heartfelt feelings into it!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It looks delicious...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Because so many precious 
feelings have been poured into this treat.
